Transaction in Own Shares Computacenter PLC 30 October 2024 Computacenter plc Incorporated in England Registration number: 03110569 LEI: 549300XSXUZ1I19DB105 ISIN: GB00BV9FP302 Computacenter plc Transaction in own shares Computacenter plc (the Company ) announces that on 30 October 2024 it purchased through J.P. Morgan Securities plc 20,006 Computacenter plc ordinary shares of 7 5 / 9 pence each, at a volume weighted average price paid (per ordinary share) of 2283.5201 pence, pursuant to its Share Buy-back Programme, the details of which were announced on 26 July 2024. This transaction concludes the Share Buy-back Programme. Computacenter plc Transaction details: Computacenter plc ordinary shares of 7 5 / 9 pence each Issuer Name: Computacenter plc ISIN Number: GB00BV9FP302 Intermediary Name: J.P. Morgan Securities plc Intermediary Code: JPMSGB2LXXX Time Zone: BST Currency: GBP Aggregated Information: London Stock Exchange Number of ordinary shares purchased 20,006 Highest price paid (pence per ordinary share) 2312.0000 Lowest price paid (pence per ordinary share) 2268.0000 Volume weighted average price paid (pence per ordinary share) 2283.5201 The Company intends to hold the purchased shares in treasury. Following the above transaction, the Company holds 11,444,039 of its ordinary shares in treasury and has 106,243,931 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). Since 26 July 2024, Computacenter plc has purchased 7,897,178 ordinary shares. In accordance with Article 5(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 (as it forms part of UK law pursuant to the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018) (the Market Abuse Regulation), detailed information
